notes.title: Update 0.16
notes.notes:
Content

 Added Early Access disclaimer.
 You can now create offline lobbies!
 When a game is finished, you can now go back to the lobby directly instead of having to create a new one!
 When hovering over a resource at the top of the screen, a description of that resource will now be shown.
 Added indicators to the lobby for when a player has loaded into the lobby.
 Added feedback when joining a public lobby through the lobby browser.

Weapon Skins

 AR-15 - Ice
Added ice projectiles and target hit effects using the improved cosmetics system.

Balancing

 The chance of finding any item decreases with the amount of items of that specific type that is currently in your inventory. This decrease per existing item has been changed from 5% to 15% cumulatively.

Changes

 Rewritten a lot of the cosmetics code to allow for more flexibility and customization for future skins. I also broke all my skin prefabs and had to fix those because I moved a script inside Visual Studio instead of in Unity and Unity didn't like that and decided that all the data stored on the prefabs that had these scripts would be lost. Thanks Unity.
 You can now easily change your currently selected item by clicking another item instead of having to press escape to cancel the current selection.
 You will now only join a public lobby when double clicking it.
 Clients can no longer see the button for adding bots in lobbies.
 Music is no longer synced between clients.

Fixes

 Fixed Orbital Strike kill message.
 Fixed not being able to use items on revealed invisible enemy units (e.g. when a unit is being revealed by a ghost).
 Fixed missing particle effects that have been broken by Unity's Universal Render Pipeline.
 Particle effects on entities should no longer be shown to players that don't see that entity.
 Fixed (hopefully) not receiving game modes from public lobbies.
 Clients should no longer be able to connect multiple times to the same server.
 When a lobby you are in closes, you will now return to the main menu.
 Fixed that a player connecting to a finished game will cause the player's game to be stuck in a game without a win screen, forcing the player to disconnect from the lobby.
 Some minor fixes.

notes.title: Update 0.15
notes.notes:
Content

 Added a leveling system! You start each game on level 0. Different actions reward the player with experience. All trait shop items have been converted to skills that automatically level up as you level up.

You need 20 XP for the first level. Every level requires 2 more XP than the level before.

XP rewarding actions:
-Moving: Every 5 fields moved by your units rewards 1 XP
-Kills: Killing an enemy unit rewards 4 XP
-Deaths: When one of your units dies, you receive 20 XP
 The taskbar icon now flashes on Windows when the current player's turn begins and the window is not focused.
 Added an option to disable auto auto camera when a controller is detected
 Added particle effects for spawning placeables and using items on units to make it clear where things have happened

Balancing

 [Cultist]
  -Owned gold mines now generate 1  Faith per turn.
 [Cultist] Possess Gold Mine:
  -Max uses per turn: no limit => 1
  -Cost: 5 Gold, 50 Faith => 5 Gold, 80 Faith

Changes

 Moved UI of the roll timer and the UI that shows the dice rolls left

Fixes

 Fixed unit skins changing when editing input fields in the customizer.
 Fixed various localization keys.
 Fixed ducks trying to move into the safety zone, which is not possible for non-units, which resulted in an eternally moving duck.
 Fixed the barricade vanishing on the wrong player's turn.
 Fixed an exception when bots tried to use missing data from the last match in the current match for a chat message.
 Fixed the starting player not having 3 tries to roll a 6.
 The chat is no longer cleared when going to the main menu and back to the lobby

notes.notes:
Changes

 Players will only get skipped when they cannot do any valid move and they have no items in their inventory.
 When a player is skipped, the game will show an alert now.

Fixes

 Fixed units not being clickable when shield bubbles are active.
 Fixed a bug that status effects are still active one turn after they reached ticked down (visually they were not shown anymore though).
 Fixed shop UI sometimes not initializing.

notes.title: Update 0.5.9
notes.notes:
Content

 Player status effects (e.g. bonus die) are now shown below the player info.
 Added poisoning particle effect.
 Item: Antidote - Cures a poisoned unit.
 Item: Poison Bomb - Poisons all units that are not invincible.
 Item: Shield Bubbles - Gives all your units a shield bubble, protecting them from any damage for one round.

Changes

 Made status effect durations more visible.
 Made nuke explosion notification an alert.

Fixes

 Possibly fixed a bug that status effects visually don't get removed from invisible units after death.
 Fixed playlist sometimes stopping after a track has finished.
 Fixed player resource UI sometimes not loading correctly.
 Fixed player inventory UI sometimes not loading correctly.

notes.title: Update 0.5.8
notes.notes:
Content

 Item: Hopper Mine - Explodes when touching a unit. Jumps back 3 fields every turn.

Changes

 Item Swap weight decreased: 8 -> 7

Fixes

 Fixed alerts not resetting transparency in some cases.
 Fixed chat not clearing when joining a new lobby.
 Fixed item info popup staying active after using the last item.
 Fixed swap on a gold mine sometimes not changing the owner to the new unit.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused item target selection to not work.
 Maybe fixed a desync bug when starting a game?
 Fixed clicking an item or shop item triggering the click event twice.
 Fixed overlapping danger markers not working properly.

notes.title: Update 0.5.7
notes.notes:
Content

 Added squads: Create a squad and give your units custom names!

Changes

 Main menu UI background sprite changed.

notes.title: Update 0.5.6
notes.notes:
Content

 Added alerts and floating texts for dice results.
 Income per turn is now displayed for resources.
 Shop item: Passive Income (10 death coins) - increases passive gold income by +1.

Changes

 Reworked inventory UI
 Removed redundant bot takeover message.
 Gave chat messages an outline to increase visiblity.
 Made floating texts white with black outline.
 Changed gold mine team indicator.
 Assassination messages are now alerts.
 Added and changed gold mine notifications.
 Item Boost decreased weight per round change: 0.1 -> -0.05
 Item Booster decreased weight per round change: 0.1 -> -0.05
 Item Swap decreased weight per round change: 0.05 -> -0.01

Fixes

 Fixed status effects ticking down faster for clients.
 Player place is now localized.
 Assassination messages are now localized.

notes.title: Update 0.5.5
notes.notes:
Changes

 Made music spam message an alert.
 Moved status effect messages to alerts.

Fixes

 Music spam message is now localized.

notes.title: Update 0.5.4
notes.notes:
Content

 When a gold mine generates gold, the owner will now see a floating text above the gold mine to indicate that.
 When the bomb reaches 3 turns left, an indicator will show which fields are going to be affected by the explosion.

Changes

 Made gold mine flag's color not be affected by lighting to easier identify the owner.
 Item Move 3 weight decreased: 10 -> 5
 Item Move 3 weight change per round decreased: 0.1 -> 0.05
 Moved more notifications to alerts.
 Unit and field selections can now be aborted by pressing escape.
 Status effects will now face the camera.

Fixes

 Bombs will now properly make units explode.
 The game will now properly wait for events to finish before ending a player's turn.
 Turn end events will now be triggered on the client as well.

notes.title: Update 0.5.3
notes.notes:
Changes

 Decreased size of alerts.

Fixes

 Fixed soft lock when sending localized strings.

notes.title: Update 0.5.2
notes.notes:
Content

 Added alerts that popup on the right side of the screen to remove clutter from the chat.

Changes

 Shield weight: 10 -> 5
 Shield weight change per round: 0.1 -> 0.01
 Invincible units will no longer be stunned by a bear trap.
 Increased start gold: 10 -> 20
 Shop item Out of House increased price: 10 -> 20
 Shop item Interrupt increased price: 10 -> 20
 Shop item Supply Crate increased price: 10 -> 30
 Target selection will no longer show assassination circles for offensive items.

Fixes

 Fixed gold mines not generating gold.
 Players can no longer choose invalid units or fields as they are now validated by the server.
 Fixed field selection wrongly showing fields with already placed objects on them as valid.
 Invisible enemy units are no longer selectable.
 Fixed 'Interrupt' shop item.
 Death coins should show the right amount now.
 Removed status effects will now be removed on clients as well.
 Duck should not get out of sync as much anymore.
 Assassination marker should now show and disappear correctly.

notes.title: Update 0.5.1
notes.notes:
Changes

 Improved player info text visiblity.

Fixes

 Fixed German bomb and booster placing notifications.
 Fixed death coin text for German translation.
 Fixed Resources not updating.
 Fixed supply crates not deregistering from fields when collected.
 Hopefully, fixed that units can move backwards beyond their start field.

notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.notes:
Content

 Added button to lobby for copying the lobby ID to the clipboard.
 Item: Bear trap - Spawns a bear trap that will stun units for 2 rounds.
 Item: Booster - Spawns a booster that will boost units for 3 rounds.
 Item: Bomb - Spawns a bomb that will explode after 10 turns, killing every unit on its field, the field after it and the field before it.
 Added gold and a shop to buy stuff with it.
Every player will receive 1 Gold per turn.
 Shop item: Out of House item
 Shop item: Interrupt - Throws rolling dice back into the air.
 Shop item: Supply crate - Adds a random item to your inventory.
 Added buildings that can be captured by placing a unit on its associated field.
 Building: gold mine - Generates 1 gold per turn for the player that controls  it.

Changes

 Lobby ID text field removed from lobby (replaced by copy button)
 Overhauled selection markers:
yellow -> selectable
green -> selected
Also, the new system makes field selection markers possible.
 Updated localization tool to the newest version.
 Improved logic for detecting whether or not an item can be activated.
 Player inventory has a background now.

Fixes

 Status effect notifications for units are now localized.
 Players are now able to toggle their own AFK state through the player context menu.
 Bot takeover notifications are now localized.
 AFK notifications are now localized.
 Name change notifications are now localized.
 Improved connection logic when joining a game. There should be fewer desyncs when reconnecting.
 You can no longer trigger the TV screen through UI and vice versa.
I don't know why that fixes it, but I just turn the screen off and on again when loading the game.
 Hopefully, fixed that not all status effects are visually removed when a unit respawns.

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.notes:
Content

 Added configs to control if the player can choose item targets or if targets a chosen randomly!
The host can change this for every item category in the lobby configs.
 Added support for nested localized strings (e.g. when receiving an item, the localized notification contains the localized name of the item)
 Added item for swapping 2 units

Changes

 Non-player kills will now increase the death counter of the killed unit's owner (e.g. duck)
 Decreased max moves between item crate spawns (16 -> 14)
 Auto camera improvements
 Increased Out of House start item weight (0.5 -> 1)
 Changed duck to stay for a fixed amount of moves (20) instead of 8 rounds
 Changed endscreen stats to exclude most collected items
 Changed some UI textures

Fixes

 Fixed server instance always being initialized with MaxClientCount=5 and thus rejecting further connections
 Fixed NetworkedObjects (like networked events) not unregistering when be disposed
 Fixed networked actions not being received by clients since I forgot to create the receiver functions.. oops

notes.title: Update 0.3.6
notes.notes:
Content

 Added first iteration of auto camera (toggle with F2)

Fixes

 Fixed end screen not showing up for clients

notes.title: Update 0.3.5
notes.notes:
Fixes

 Fixed collecting items throwing an exception

notes.title: Update 0.3.4
notes.notes:
Content

 Added dice stats so players can complain about their luck!
 Added quit button
 Added game menu (open using Escape key in-game)
 Added invite button to lobby menu
 Invited players will now automatically connect to the lobby when clicking on the invitation
 Added an end screen

Changes

 Increased grenade explosion power
 Increased SMAW explosion power
 Increased nuke explosion power
 Improved changelog formatting
 Slightly changed button sprites

Fixes

 Players should no longer be able to use the "Retreat" card to move further back than their start field
 The game will now wait for events to finish before calculating valid units to choose from (should fix a bug were the player is stuck in house after a unit has been declared valid but is being killed afterwards)
 Fixed available cards not being updated when a duck move has finished
 Bots react to messages again!
 Fixed teleported units not killing enemies
 Fixed SMAW collision box being way too big
 Fixed unit click hitbox blocking flying unit limbs
 Units will now move to their destination before other actions can be executed
 Fixed skins of bots not loading for players joining a running game
 Players no longer have to wait for events before assassinating someone
 Fixed softlock when having units in house while the start field is blocked by an invincible unit and the player rolled a 6

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.1
notes.notes:
Fixes

 Fixed kills not being recognized when the attacker uses the new skin (the new weapons didn't know who their owner is)
 Fixed the new skin not being affected by invisibility

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.notes:
Content

 Added a new skin type: Blob!

Changes

 Switched rendering to Universal Render Pipeline to improve on lighting and effects
 Improved lighting in living room environment (not in main menu)
 Added some bloom
 Made dice colors more saturated to make the owner clearer
 Improved lobby skin preview
 Removed the ability to switch skins in the lobby menu

Fixes

 Fixed next player being skipped when a player finishes
 Fixed the host not seeing synced particle effects
 Fixed soldier skin not working

notes.title: Update 0.2.2
notes.notes:
Content

 Added crate breaking animation
 Added effects when reaching safety

Changes

 Changed crate collection sound
 Changed player info background texture
 Crate jumping animation is no longer synced to reduce network usage

notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.notes:
Content

 added context menu to players in game
 added lobby options
 added 'forcenextplayer' command (host only) to force the game to skip to the next player in case of a softlock

Changes

 reduced duck card weight 6 -> 4
 increased nuke weight 0.5 -> 1
 the game will now always wait for dying units to respawn
 music now starts playing when starting the game
 music is now synced to newly joining players
 music doesn't stop anymore when starting a game
 reduced rage and desperation indicators to only show up when above a treshold of 5
 the game now loads the environment first and loads the map into it instead of loading the map first and surrounding it with the environment (may create bugs, but makes future map customization easier)

Fixes

 fixed next player being able to roll the dice before the duck has finished moving
 fixed a backward walking bug on map Tiny2
 fixed the duck not making a kill sound when a unit walks onto it's field
 removed the invisible scrollbar behind the item card to reduce confusion when trying to click to roll the dice
